title: Max-$k$-Cut via Node Features
summary: We study the Max-$k$-Cut problem from a node-feature perspective, where each vertex is associated with a feature vector and edge weights are given by pairwise inner products. We first examine the semidefinite relaxation of Max-$k$-Cut from this perspective.
